answer: Require each identity to escrow a 780-unit bond and serve a thirty-six epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for sixteen rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm thus locks 780 units per alias and replays thirty-six rounds, while a glacier of linked traces exposes the ring, pulse calibration salts each task, and trellis records preserve audit trails.
